_note: DEVELOPMENT / TEST RULES ONLY. These are NOT official NHCX payer rules. Configure NHCX_RULES_PATH env var to load official rules when available.

rules.description: Claim must include at least one Condition coding
rules.message: NHCX claim must include at least one Condition coding.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a Condition resource with a valid coding to the Bundle.

rules.description: Condition coding must have a recognised AYUSH system URI
rules.message: Condition coding system is not a recognised AYUSH or standard medical system.
rules.suggestedFix: Use a recognised coding system such as the NAMASTE URI or ICD-11 MMS URI.

rules.description: Claim should include a TM2 code for traditional medicine conditions
rules.message: No TM2 code found in condition codings. NHCX recommends including a TM2 code for traditional medicine claims.
rules.suggestedFix: Map the AYUSH condition to its corresponding ICD-11 TM2 code and include it in the Bundle.
